command: async(page)=>{const b=page.getByRole("region",{name:"About Blake Giunta",exact:true}),g=page.getByRole("figure",{name:"Bar height shows the number of published scorecards in each range.",exact:true});await b.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();const bb=await b.boundingBox(),gb=await g.boundingBox();if(!(bb.y+bb.height<=gb.y+1))throw Error("Biography must precede graph vertically");if(!await page.getByRole("link",{name:/Matt Dillahunty vs Blake Giunta/}).count())throw Error("Missing debate");await page.screenshot({path:"output/playwright/debate-266/mobile-profile.png"});return {status:"passed",biography:bb,graph:gb,viewport:page.viewportSize()}}
